old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-cjbc","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: EDHOC TH_2 input missing C_R per RFC 9528","description":"Per RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2, TH_2_input = ( G_Y, C_R, H(message_1) ). The EDHOC implementation in edhoc.py lines 389 and 598 computes TH_2_input from only two CBOR items (G_Y + H(message_1)) but omits C_R (connection identifier chosen by responder). This is a spec-compliance and potential security issue: omitting C_R from the transcript hash means the responder's chosen connection identifier is not bound to the session, which could enable cross-session attacks or transcript hash mismatch with compliant peers.
